description: Source code implementing RC2 cipher encryption and decryption functions, including CBC mode, key setup, and related macros, for the BoringSSL library.

classes.name: EVP_RC2_KEY
classes.description: Structure holding the effective key bits and RC2 key schedule.

methods.name: rc2_init_key
methods.description: Initializes the RC2 key schedule with provided key and parameters.

methods.name: rc2_cbc_cipher
methods.description: Performs CBC mode encryption or decryption using RC2.

methods.name: rc2_ctrl
methods.description: Handles control commands for RC2 cipher context, such as setting key bits.

methods.name: EVP_rc2_40_cbc
methods.description: Returns the EVP_CIPHER structure for 40-bit RC2 CBC mode.

methods.name: EVP_rc2_cbc
methods.description: Returns the EVP_CIPHER structure for 128-bit RC2 CBC mode.
